newsitem.title: GREECE: Albanian workers protest at their Athens embassy.
newsitem.headline: Albanian workers protest at their Athens embassy.

text.p: About 200 Albanian immigrants protested at their embassy in Athens on Sunday over lost savings in collapsed pyramid investment schemes back home.
Shouting slogans such as "We want our money" and "No more poverty" the protesters marched to the embassy in the central Athens Kolonaki district. They dispersed after handing in a protest letter.
"I have worked in Greece for two years. I send my money home. Now it's lost," one protester told television channels.
Hundreds of thousands of Albanians have illegally crossed the border into Greece to find work and support families back home after the collapse of communism in Europe's poorest country.
Investors in the pyramid schemes have staged protests throughout Albania, demanding compensation for their losses from the Tirana government.
